evidence: Optimizes CBlockIndexWorkComparator in src/node/blockstorage.h and arith_uint256, touching block-index ordering used in chain selection.
rationale: Inlining block index and arith_uint256 comparisons speeds up hot-path comparisons without altering consensus or chainstate logic. Benchmarks indicate synthetic work comparisons are ~6.5x faster and CheckBlockIndex is ~1.5x faster, but the real-world impact on overall block connection or IBD time is modest.
